name: Home-video tape · Tested
about: Every setting of the engine pipeline, proven on a full restoration of a two-hour VHS tape (720x480 29.97i MPEG-2) on an 8 GB NVIDIA graphics card, October-November 2026. The script and argument for each value are noted next to it; engine/tapewake_engine/settings.py TESTED holds the values a job can override.

source.timeline: fps=30000/1001:start_time=0 (constant frame rate, fills one-frame timestamp holes in old captures)
source.colour_in: BT.601 limited range (smpte170m), as in the original MPEG-2
source.cut: lossless FFV1 level 3 pieces of 1000 source frames (prepare.py, setting piece_frames)
source.audio_channel: both by default; 'left' or 'right' (setting audio_channel) when one channel of a tape is dead

deinterlace.source_match_mode: BASIC  # keeps source detail, turns off QTGMC sharpening
deinterlace.mvtools_fix: vsjetpack 2.2.6 passes fields=<bool> that mvutensils 10 rejects: patch MVTools.__init__ to store None (see deinterlace.py)

upscale.model: Real-ESRGAN realesr-general-x4v3 (compact model, 64 features, 32 convs, x4) blended with realesr-general-wdn-x4v3
upscale.runtime: TensorRT 10.9 FP16 engine, 1 GB workspace, built for 640x480 (about 2x PyTorch; 57.7 dB PSNR vs PyTorch). Falls back to PyTorch.

flicker_smoothing.flow: RAFT large (torchvision), computed on the source

detect.detector: RetinaFace ResNet50 (CodeFormer facelib) on a 2x enlarged frame, conf 0.6

restore.model: DicFace (ICCV 2025) bfr_100k.pth, 5-frame window per frame, w=1.0
restore.precision: full (fp16 turns KEEP black; FP16 CodeFormer scored 34.8 dB worst face - rejected)

finish.sharpen_note: luma-only unsharp mask, 5x5 Gaussian; level 3 (1.8) looked best on the test tape
finish.delivery: libx264 -crf 14 -preset slow, yuv420p, converted to BT.709 (out_color_matrix=bt709), tagged colorspace bt709 / primaries smpte170m / trc bt709 / range tv

audio.separation: Demucs htdemucs, shifts=1, split, overlap 0.25 (vocals vs background)

voices.talking: AI_LIGHT = Resemble Enhance lambd=0.5, nfe=64, midpoint, tau=0.5, loudness matched to DeepFilterNet3 version
voices.blend: talking share = (voice/mix power over 2 s - 0.35) / 0.4, clipped 0..1

audio.loudness: two-pass loudnorm I=-16 TP=-1.5 LRA=11 linear=true
audio.checks: length within 10 ms, sync within 10 ms at 10 points, loudness within 0.7 LU, peak <= 0.95
audio.study_result: DNSMOS overall, talking: tape 1.38, NEW 1.26, AI 1.63, AI_LIGHT 1.65; songs all ~1.09 so the least-changing (NEW) won

outputs.restored: <name> - Restored.mkv: H.264 1280x960 59.94p + restored FLAC (track 1) + original audio (track 2); published only after frame-count, track and duration checks
outputs.compare: Before and after.mp4: original (bwdif send_field, bicubic to 1280x960) | restored, labelled, hevc_nvenc p7 hq cq 18, 256k AAC

run.unit: pieces of 1000 source frames, resumable, each verified by frame count
run.overlap: composite (CPU) of piece k runs while piece k+1 is on the GPU
run.pause: PAUSED flag file + kill all job processes (frees GPU memory for games)
run.disk: deinterlace at most 8 pieces ahead of the GPU (qtgmc_ahead); delete each deinterlaced piece once it and both neighbours are restored, and the rest of qtgmc/ and work/ after the final checks (keep_work_files: false). Measured per hour of tape: source cut 11 GB, deinterlaced 36 GB, restored pieces 17.5 GB, finished video 17.5 GB. Peak about 50 GB per hour; Free up space in the app deletes the source cut and pieces afterwards
run.measured: piece step shares: finding faces 0.32, restoring faces 0.48, upscaling 0.15 (TensorRT), assembling 0.05; ~30-75 min per 2000-frame piece
